patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high-contrast dark and light backgrounds to delineate content blocks.
A distinctive, rounded, playful sans-serif font is used for prominent headings, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A vibrant, pastel-neon accent palette is used for interactive elements and illustrations, standing out against stark dark (near-black) or clean white backgrounds.
The hero section features a background illustration that parallaxes behind the fixed foreground text and call-to-action as the user scrolls down the page.
The navigation bar transforms from a transparent, larger state to a smaller, sticky version with a solid dark background and a reduced logo size upon scrolling past the hero section.
Large, illustrative character grids are used to showcase community members or product variations, creating a visually rich and engaging display.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section incorporates a large, detailed illustration where the background layer moves at a slower rate than the foreground text and button elements, creating a sense of depth through parallax scrolling.

The site's primary navigation bar is initially transparent and full-height, overlaying the hero content. As the user scrolls down, it dynamically shrinks in height, gains a solid dark background, and becomes fixed to the top of the viewport, with the logo also scaling down.

Interactive horizontal carousels, powered by a swiper-like mechanism, are used to display collections of items such as products or content pieces, allowing users to navigate through them with swipe gestures or navigation controls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, rounded headings (~3-4x body) are used for section titles, with smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and very small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card elements, maintaining a generally soft but not overly bubbly aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with airy sections, particularly the hero, transitioning to a more compact but still comfortable density in content grids and product displays.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its pervasive use of highly stylized, playful, and colorful character illustrations, which are central to the brand identity and integrated into every section, creating a unique blend of whimsical art and digital collectibles that feels both premium and approachable.
